releases.notes: Initial release of the mod. Was previously Golden Tweaks, renamed to Retro Tweaks. ## What's Changed * add old features from retrotweaks by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/1 * make minecraft logo render in same position as beta 173 by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/2 * old button colors tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/3 * infdev loading screen tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/4 * add beta pause menu tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/5 * add old world loading screen tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/6 * old hud tweak, remove xp bar tweak and fixes by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/8 * old death screen tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/9 * old crosshair tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/10 * move system messages to chat tweak and beta chat tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/11 * add top left version text tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/12 * add old bossbar tweak, hide action bar tweak and hide extra tooltip info tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/13 * add instant consumption tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/14 * fix boss bar not emptying by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/15 * add remove hunger tweak and sprinting style tweak by @GameMasterPDX in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/16 * Merge development into main by @PoeticRainbow in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/18 * Add Minecraft version to the jar name by @PoeticRainbow in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/19 * Fix miscellaneous header by @PoeticRainbow in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/20 ## New Contributors * @GameMasterPDX made their first contribution in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/1 * @PoeticRainbow made their first contribution in https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/pull/18 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/retro-tweaks/commits/0.0.1
